selection: Complete Dec2Hex and strong-enum Find files, plus selected built-in enum cases with literal or binding-error oracles for ErrorKind, StartOfWeek, TimeUnit, SortOrder and DateTimeFormat. Independent decoding, explicit host profiles. Calculated enum oracles lack backing values; unsupported functions and computed expected formulas remain outside the selection.

cases.known_gap: Canvas documentation specifies truncation toward zero (-3); the pinned interpreter floors (-4). The simulator follows the Canvas contract.
